Package org.jdesktop.lg3d.wg

Class Animation

java.lang.Object
org.jdesktop.lg3d.wg.Animation
All Implemented Interfaces:
LgEventSource
Direct Known Subclasses:
Component3DAnimation, TimedAnimation
public abstract class Animation extends Object implements LgEventSource
Superclass of all animations. Conceptually an animation is an action which acts on an AnimationTarget. However this is not actually a subclass of action.

    • getAnimationParameters

      protected abstract EnumSet<Animation.AnimationType> getAnimationParameters()
      Subclasses must override this method to specific which things they will animate. For example return EnumSet.of(AnimationType.TRANSFORM); return EnumSet.of(AnimationType.TRANSFORM, AnimationType.TRANSPARENCY);

    • initialize

      public abstract void initialize()
      A callback invoked right after the target gets set in order to initizalize this animation and the target's visual before making the target visible.

    • destroy

      public abstract void destroy()
      A callback invoked right before the target gets reset to null. By the time this is called the Animation is no longer running (isRunning()==false).
